records.name: Themes entry
records.purpose: The package entry barrel that selects which theme contract, preset and application function are public.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). src/index.ts re-exports the whole contract barrel, the single named value auraPreset from presets/aura, and applyUltimateTheme plus the type ApplyUltimateThemeOptions from apply-theme. Availability is internal because the barrel owns no export identities; the identities it forwards are attributed to the contract, apply and aura records.

records.name: Theme contract, mode and direction
records.purpose: TypeScript-only description of the theme token shapes (primitive, semantic, component) and the supported mode and direction values; carries no runtime behavior.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Root exports the types ColorScale, PrimitiveTokens, SemanticColorScheme, SemanticTokens, ComponentTokens, UltimateThemeMode and UltimateThemeDirection. UltimateThemeMode is "system" | "light" | "dark" | string, so it accepts any string; UltimateThemeDirection is "ltr" | "rtl" and is a documentation type, not a runtime mechanism. The barrel src/contract/index.ts re-exports tokens, mode and direction.

records.name: applyUltimateTheme
records.purpose: Framework-agnostic entry point that configures the shared uix-styled Theme singleton with a preset, a dark-mode selector and CSS-layer options.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Root exports the function applyUltimateTheme(options?: ApplyUltimateThemeOptions): void and the interface ApplyUltimateThemeOptions { preset?: Record<string, unknown>; darkModeSelector?: UltimateThemeMode; cssLayer?: boolean | { name?: string; order?: string } }. Defaults: preset auraPreset, darkModeSelector "system", cssLayer false. It calls Theme.setTheme with a fixed options.prefix of "u"; the prefix is not configurable.

records.name: Aura preset
records.purpose: The public Aura-derived preset object built with definePreset from the primitive and semantic base tiers and the registered component token modules.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Root exports the value auraPreset only. src/presets/aura/index.ts builds it with definePreset({ primitive, semantic, components }) and registers 79 component modules under lower-case upstream-style keys (for example blockui, cascadeselect, datepicker). The base tier is attributed to themes.aura-base and the component modules to themes.aura-components; neither is a separate root entry point.

records.name: Aura primitive and semantic base tiers
records.purpose: Constituent data of the Aura preset: the primitive tier (border-radius scale and 22 named color ramps) and the semantic tier (focus ring, primary ramp, form-field, list, content, mask, navigation, overlay and light/dark colorScheme tokens).
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Not independently reachable from the package root. base.ts exports the constants primitive: PrimitiveTokens and semantic: SemanticTokens, both consumed only by presets/aura/index.ts. Primitive keys: borderRadius plus 22 color ramps (emerald through stone). Semantic keys: transitionDuration, focusRing, disabledOpacity, iconSize, anchorGutter, primary, formField, list, content, mask, navigation, overlay, colorScheme.

records.name: Aura component token modules
records.purpose: Constituent per-component design-token modules registered by the Aura preset: 79 files, each exporting a token constant and, in 76 of them, a token interface.
records.surface: See [authored signatures and interpretation](README.md). Not independently reachable from the package root; each constant (for example button, checkbox, dialog, menu, tooltip, paginator) is imported only by presets/aura/index.ts and registered under a lower-case key, so the token interfaces (for example ButtonColorSchemeTokens, TooltipColorSchemeTokens) are not importable from @ultimate/themes. 25 modules import contract types; the others declare module-local shapes. progress-spinner, select-button and skeleton export no interface.
